title: rotini structured report line
description: One line rotini.StructuredReporter writes to stderr when the program's own rule says the run is structured: a JSON object holding one error, warning, info or success, in the order the default reporter prints them (info, warning, error, success). A field is present only when rotini knows it. Secrets never appear.

error.description: An error. The run exits with exit_code.

message.description: The message the default reporter would print, without the program name.

category.description: usage: the command line or its inputs were wrong, and the user can fix it. internal: a bug or misconfiguration in the program. none: anything else.

kind.description: What went wrong, when rotini's typed error says: a parse failure's kind (unknown-flag, invalid-value, missing-required, …) or a plugin failure's (binary-not-found, spawn-failed, timeout).

command.description: The command the error happened in, as typed: "taskr list".

flag.description: The flag involved, by the identifier the user typed.

token.description: The command-line token or value at fault.

exit_code.description: The code the run exits with, decided as the default reporter decides it.

warning.description: A warning. It does not change the exit code.

message.description: The message the default reporter would print, without the program name.

command.description: The command the warning happened in, as typed.

info.description: A message the default reporter would print to stdout before everything else.

command.description: The command that recorded it, as typed.

success.description: A message the default reporter would print to stdout after everything else.

command.description: The command that recorded it, as typed.
